features: 【Powerful Bass】The Mini wireless speaker delivers 5W stereo sound,The redesigned tweeter provides extra stability for crisp highs and rich mid-range tones while the woofer’s material and structure helps minimize low-end distortion even at high volumes,making you feel like you're in the middle of a live music scene Thunder Eagle.

【Small But Powerful, Battery Life 8Hrs】 Delivers up to 8 hours of continuous playback time with a 1.5 hour recharge time. Our tested 8-hour battery life is based on laboratory results under specific conditions: playing music at 45% volume. For optimal battery performance, we recommend adjusting the volume and usage according to your needs.Note:The volume of the audio and the previous song and the next song need to be debugged through the cell phone.

【Bluetooth 5.3 and Wide compatibility】 The portable wireless speaker adopts advanced Bluetooth 5.3 technology,can connect to devices from up to 33 feet away without obstructions.and the signal won't be interfered with, even in harsh conditions.Wide compatibility, pairs with most Bluetooth-enabled devices, such as mobile phones, MP3, TVs, tablets, laptop devices.

【IPX7 Waterproof and Durable】 The waterproof bluetooth speaker has an IPX7 waterproof rating to withstand rain, spills and splashes. You can take your portable bluetooth speaker with you to enjoy riding, camping, beach, hiking and other scenarios anytime and anywhere without worrying about the weather and outdoor conditions.

【Lightweight Portable Speaker】 This small speaker weighs less than 0.2 pounds, is incredibly lightweight. It is even smaller than a phone and comes with a convenient strap-to-anything lanyard, easy to hang it on your handbag, backpack, car, or bike effortlessly. A classic design refined with simple controls and effortless portability. Its light and smooth round body add to its appeal as a stylish fashion accessory
